title: Friendship and Peer Pressure: The Compass of Values
summary: The influence of friends grows at this age, and pressure may push your child to do something contrary to their values just to be accepted. Do not attack their friends; instead, strengthen their inner compass. Discuss hypothetical situations with them («What would you do if…»), and teach them to say «no» with confidence without losing their friends.
try_this: This week: Present your child with a hypothetical situation about peer pressure, and ask them how they would act and why.
reflection_prompts: Who influences your child the most?
Can they refuse what contradicts their values?
